subScenes.name: 寻找工具
subScenes.description: 顾客向店员说明需要购买电钻，描述使用场景和基本需求。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问具体工具是否有货

followUps.text: Yes, we have several types — standard, claw, and sledge. Which one do you need?
followUps.text_cn: 有的，我们有几种：普通锤、羊角锤和大锤。您要哪一种？

followUps.text: Sorry, we're out of hammers right now, but we expect a shipment tomorrow.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，目前锤子缺货，但明天到货。

followUps.text: We don't keep hammers on the floor — let me get one from the back for you.
followUps.text_cn: 锤子不摆在外架，我到后面给您拿一个。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客询问具体工具库存时的典型回应，涵盖有货、缺货、需取货三种情况

qaPairs.triggerText: Are you looking for something specific?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您在找什么具体的工具吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 店员主动询问顾客需求以提供帮助

followUps.text: Yes, I need a 10mm socket wrench for my car repair.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，我需要一个10毫米的套筒扳手修车。

followUps.text: I'm not sure — I need to fix a leaky faucet, but I don't know what tool to use.
followUps.text_cn: 我不确定——我需要修一个漏水的水龙头，但不知道该用什么工具。

followUps.text: Just something to tighten these bolts — any basic set will do.
followUps.text_cn: 随便找个能拧紧这些螺栓的就行，基本工具套装就行。

qaPairs.usageNote: 店员主动询问时，顾客可能清晰表达、模糊求助或接受建议，体现真实交流多样性

qaPairs.triggerText: Can you show me where the screwdrivers are?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你能带我去看看螺丝刀在哪吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客请求引导至工具摆放区

followUps.text: Sure, they're in aisle 3, right next to the pliers — I'll walk you there.
followUps.text_cn: 当然，三号通道，和钳子放在一起——我带您去。

followUps.text: They're on the third shelf in the tool wall — just look for the red handles.
followUps.text_cn: 在工具墙的第三层，找红色手柄的就行。

followUps.text: We have two types — flathead and Phillips. Let me grab a few for you to choose from.
followUps.text_cn: 我们有两种：一字和十字，我拿几个让您选一下。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客请求指引时，店员可能陪同、指示或主动取货，体现服务主动性差异

subScenes.name: 询问功能
subScenes.description: 顾客咨询电钻电池续航、转速和重量等关键性能参数。

qaPairs.triggerText: This hammer is for driving nails, right?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 这个锤子是用来钉钉子的，对吧？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客确认工具基本功能

followUps.text: Yes, it's a standard claw hammer designed for driving nails and pulling them out.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，这是标准的羊角锤，用于钉钉子和拔钉子。

followUps.text: Actually, it's also great for light demolition work like breaking tiles or drywall.
followUps.text_cn: 实际上，它也适合轻度拆除工作，比如砸瓷砖或石膏板。

followUps.text: Not quite — this is a ball-peen hammer, better for metalworking, not nails.
followUps.text_cn: 不太对——这是圆头锤，适合金属加工，不是用来钉钉子的。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客在不确定工具用途时，用此句确认，服务员需根据实际工具类型给出准确回应。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you need this wrench for tightening bolts or loosening them?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您是要用这个扳手来拧紧螺栓还是松开螺栓？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 店员询问具体使用目的以推荐合适工具

followUps.text: I need to tighten them — they're loose on my bike.
followUps.text_cn: 我要拧紧它们——我的自行车螺栓松了。

followUps.text: I'm loosening them to replace a part.
followUps.text_cn: 我要松开它们来更换零件。

followUps.text: I'm not sure — I just need something that fits this size.
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，我只需要一个能匹配这个尺寸的。

qaPairs.usageNote: 店员通过此问题引导顾客明确需求，顾客应直接说明使用目的，避免模糊回答。

qaPairs.triggerText: Can this saw cut through metal?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问工具是否适用于特定材质

followUps.text: Yes, it's a metal-cutting reciprocating saw with a bi-metal blade.
followUps.text_cn: 可以，这是带双金属锯片的往复式金属切割锯。

followUps.text: No, this is a wood saw — it'll dull instantly on metal.
followUps.text_cn: 不行，这是木工锯，碰到金属会立刻变钝。

followUps.text: It can handle thin sheet metal, but for thick pipes, you'll need a different blade.
followUps.text_cn: 它可以锯薄金属板，但如果是厚管材，您需要换专用锯片。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客询问材质兼容性时，服务员需根据工具规格给出明确、有区分度的回应，避免笼统回答。

subScenes.name: 确认库存
subScenes.description: 店员检查库存，告知现货型号及备货情况，顾客确认选择。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have this hammer in stock?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你们有这种锤子现货吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客确认特定工具是否有库存

followUps.text: Yes, we have it right here in aisle 3.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，就在三号货架上。

followUps.text: Sorry, we're out of stock right now, but we can get it in by tomorrow.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，目前缺货，但明天可以到货。

followUps.text: We don't carry that model anymore — would you like a similar one?
followUps.text_cn: 我们不再卖这个型号了，要看看类似的吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客询问具体工具库存时，店员根据不同库存状态给出三种典型回应。

qaPairs.triggerText: Which size are you looking for?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 店员询问工具尺寸以确认库存匹配

followUps.text: I need the 10mm set.
followUps.text_cn: 我要10毫米的那套。

followUps.text: I'm not sure — what sizes do you have?
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，你们有哪些尺寸？

followUps.text: Does it come in 8mm or 12mm? I'm not sure which one fits.
followUps.text_cn: 有8毫米或12毫米的吗？我不确定哪个合适。

qaPairs.usageNote: 店员询问尺寸时，顾客可能明确、模糊或犹豫，需掌握三种自然回应方式。

qaPairs.triggerText: Can you check if you have a set of socket wrenches?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你能帮我查一下有没有套筒扳手吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客请求店员查询一组工具的库存情况

followUps.text: Yes, we have three sets in the back — I'll grab one for you.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，后面有三套，我马上拿一套给你。

followUps.text: We're out of stock, but I can order it for you — it'll take 2–3 days.
followUps.text_cn: 目前缺货，但我可以为您下单，需要2-3天到货。

followUps.text: We don't carry socket wrench sets anymore — only individual pieces.
followUps.text_cn: 我们不再卖成套的套筒扳手，只有单件。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客请求查询工具库存时，店员根据库存状态给出三种典型回应，涵盖即时满足、延迟满足和无解决方案。

subScenes.name: 议价折扣
subScenes.description: 顾客询问是否有折扣或赠品，店员提供促销方案并达成一致。

qaPairs.triggerText: Can you give me a discount on these tools?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客在五金店询问工具折扣

followUps.text: Sure! I can give you 15% off since you're buying three items.
followUps.text_cn: 当然！您买了三件，我可以给您打八五折。

followUps.text: I'm sorry, but our prices are already at wholesale rates — no discounts possible.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，我们的价格已经是批发价了，无法再打折。

followUps.text: If you buy the hammer and wrench together, I can knock off $5 total.
followUps.text_cn: 如果您把锤子和扳手一起买，我可以总共减5美元。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客主动议价时，服务员可能因数量、捆绑或定价政策给出不同回应，需学会识别并应对各种态度。

qaPairs.triggerText: I saw the same wrench online for less — can you match it?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我在网上看到同样的扳手更便宜，你们能价格匹配吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客以线上价格为由要求价格匹配

followUps.text: We don't do price matching, but I can throw in a free set of drill bits with this purchase.
followUps.text_cn: 我们不支持价格匹配，但买这个我可以送您一套钻头。

followUps.text: Let me check the online price — if it's the exact same model, I'll match it.
followUps.text_cn: 让我查一下网价，如果是完全相同的型号，我给您匹配。

followUps.text: We don't match online prices, but we offer a 30-day price guarantee — if it drops later, we'll refund the difference.
followUps.text_cn: 我们不匹配网价，但提供30天价格保障，如果之后降价，我们会退还差价。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客用线上价格施压时，店员可能用赠品、核查机制或价格保障作为应对策略，需掌握不同回应背后的销售逻辑。

qaPairs.triggerText: I'm just looking, but if I buy today, is there any deal?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我先看看，但如果今天买，有优惠吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客试探性询问当日购买优惠

followUps.text: Actually, we have a weekend sale — everything in this aisle is 20% off until Monday.
followUps.text_cn: 正好，我们这周末有促销——这一排商品周一前都打八折。

followUps.text: We don't have any special deals today, but I can hold this item for you for 24 hours.
followUps.text_cn: 今天没有特别优惠，但我可以为您保留这件商品24小时。

followUps.text: If you're serious about buying, I can call the manager — sometimes they approve last-minute discounts.
followUps.text_cn: 如果您真打算买，我可以叫经理，有时他们会批准临时折扣。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客试探性询问优惠时，店员可能主动告知促销、提供保留服务或建议找经理，需学会识别销售话术中的机会信号。

subScenes.name: 了解保修
subScenes.description: 顾客确认保修期限和售后政策，店员提供书面说明。

qaPairs.triggerText: Does this tool come with a warranty?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问工具是否包含保修服务

followUps.text: Yes, it comes with a 1-year limited warranty. Just keep your receipt.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，提供一年有限保修，请保留好收据。

followUps.text: No warranty on this item—it's sold as-is.
followUps.text_cn: 这个商品没有保修，售出不退不换。

followUps.text: We offer a 2-year extended warranty for $15. Would you like to add it?
followUps.text_cn: 我们可以提供2年延保服务，15美元，您要加购吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客在购买工具时确认保修范围，服务员需根据商品类型给出明确答复，包括标准保修、无保修或付费延保选项。

qaPairs.triggerText: What do I need to do if it breaks?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客进一步询问保修流程

followUps.text: Bring it back with the receipt and we'll replace it or repair it free of charge.
followUps.text_cn: 带着收据回来，我们会免费更换或维修。

followUps.text: You'll need to send it to our service center—we cover return shipping.
followUps.text_cn: 您需要寄回我们的服务中心，我们承担退货运费。

followUps.text: Warranty doesn't cover damage from misuse. You'd need to pay for repairs.
followUps.text_cn: 保修不涵盖不当使用造成的损坏，维修需自费。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客在确认保修存在后，会追问具体流程，服务员需区分责任归属，明确免费服务与自费情况。

qaPairs.triggerText: Is the warranty valid if I bought it online?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 如果我是在网上买的，保修还有效吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问跨渠道购买的保修有效性

followUps.text: Yes, as long as you have the original receipt and it's the same model we sell here.
followUps.text_cn: 可以，只要您有原始收据，且型号与我们店内销售的一致。

followUps.text: No, warranties only apply to items purchased directly from our store.
followUps.text_cn: 不行，保修仅限于本店直接购买的商品。

followUps.text: We can check the serial number online—let me look it up for you.
followUps.text_cn: 我们可以查一下序列号，我帮您查一下。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客常因线上购买产生疑虑，服务员需明确政策边界，或主动协助验证，避免客户误解。
